_description: Corridor test for Robot Ethology. Serpentine with 45 cm CLEAR corridors (25 cm builder grid x2, 50 cm centre-to-centre). Purpose: exercise PROX_THRESHOLD=20 on a corridor ABOVE the ~36 cm sensor-saturation floor. The robot should read clear when centred and correct only when it drifts. the shared 1.5x2.5 canvas (engine/arena/world.py). arena_spiral.json's 19 cm corridors are below the floor and will oscillate regardless of threshold.
